### `a_historic_england/certificate_of_immunity_points`

- `name`: Official or publisher-assigned name of the represented feature.
- `coistart`: Date on which the Certificate of Immunity took effect.
- `coiexpire`: Date on which the Certificate of Immunity expires, normally five years after issue.
- `objectid`: Source-system row identifier; useful internally but not guaranteed to remain stable between data releases.

### `a_historic_england/conservation_areas`

- `uid`: Unique identifier assigned to the conservation-area record by the source dataset.
- `name`: Official or publisher-assigned name of the represented feature.
- `date_of_de`: Date on which the local planning authority designated the conservation area.
- `date_updat`: Date on which the conservation-area record or boundary was last updated.
- `lpa`: Local planning authority responsible for designating and managing the conservation area.
- `capture_sc`: Map scale used to capture the conservation-area boundary.
- `x`: British National Grid easting in metres for the area's reference location.
- `y`: British National Grid northing in metres for the area's reference location.
- `objectid`: Source-system row identifier; useful internally but not guaranteed to remain stable between data releases.

- `grade`: Statutory listing grade: I, II* or II, indicating the building's level of special interest.

### `a_british_geological_survey/borehole_records`

- `qs`: BGS quarter-sheet code locating the borehole record, such as HP60NW.
- `numb`: Sequential borehole number within the BGS map-sheet reference.
- `bsuff`: Suffix used to distinguish boreholes sharing the same sheet and sequence number.
- `regno`: BGS borehole registration number, formed from the sheet code, number and optional suffix.
- `rt`: BGS code identifying the borehole record type, such as BJ, OE or SE.
- `grid_refer`: Ordnance Survey National Grid Reference for the borehole location.
- `confidenti`: Y/N flag indicating whether access to the borehole record is confidential.
- `strtheight`: Ground or start elevation of the borehole location relative to the recorded vertical datum.
- `name`: Official or publisher-assigned name of the represented feature.
- `length`: Recorded drilled length or total depth of the borehole, normally in metres.
- `date_known`: Recorded borehole date or year value where the drilling date is known.
- `date_k_typ`: Qualifier describing the borehole date, such as DRILLED DATE, CIRCA, PRE or NOT ENTERED.
- `date_enter`: Date on which the borehole record was entered into the source database.
- `ags_log_ur`: URL for viewing the corresponding BGS borehole record or AGS log online.

### `a_department_for_education/education_establishments`

- `urn`: Unique Reference Number assigned by the Department for Education to the establishment.
- `establishmentnumber`: DfE establishment number used with the local-authority code to identify a school.
- `establishmentname`: Official name of the education establishment.
- `opendate`: Date on which the establishment opened in its current registered form.
- `closedate`: Date on which the establishment closed; empty for establishments not recorded as closed.
- `statutorylowage`: Lowest statutory age of pupils admitted by the establishment.
- `statutoryhighage`: Highest statutory age of pupils admitted by the establishment.
- `schoolcapacity`: Recorded number of pupil places available at the establishment.
- `censusdate`: School census date to which pupil counts and related statistics apply.
- `numberofpupils`: Total pupils recorded on roll at the census date.
- `numberofboys`: Number of boys recorded on roll at the census date.
- `numberofgirls`: Number of girls recorded on roll at the census date.
- `percentagefsm`: Percentage of pupils eligible for free school meals.
- `ukprn`: UK Provider Reference Number assigned to the education provider.
- `feheidentifier`: Identifier used for a further- or higher-education provider.
- `lastchangeddate`: Date on which the establishment record was last changed.
- `street`: Street component of the establishment's postal address.
- `locality`: Locality component of the establishment's postal address.
- `address3`: Additional address line supplied for the establishment.
- `town`: Postal town or city of the establishment.
- `postcode`: Postcode of the establishment's registered site.
- `schoolwebsite`: Website address published for the establishment.
- `telephonenum`: Telephone number published for the establishment.
- `headfirstname`: Given name of the recorded headteacher or establishment leader.
- `headlastname`: Family name of the recorded headteacher or establishment leader.
- `headpreferredjobtitle`: Preferred job title of the recorded establishment leader.
- `inspectoratereport`: URL of the establishment's published inspectorate report where available.
- `dateoflastinspectionvisit`: Date of the most recent recorded inspection visit.
- `nextinspectionvisit`: Source indicator for the next inspection visit where one is recorded.
- `teenmothplaces`: Number of places provided specifically for teenage mothers.
- `placespru`: Number of places recorded for pupil referral unit provision.
- `resourcedprovisiononroll`: Pupils on roll in designated resourced special-educational-needs provision.
- `resourcedprovisioncapacity`: Recorded capacity of designated resourced special-educational-needs provision.
- `senunitonroll`: Pupils on roll in the establishment's special educational needs unit.
- `senunitcapacity`: Recorded pupil capacity of the special educational needs unit.
- `easting`: Easting coordinate in metres in the dataset's projected coordinate reference system.
- `northing`: Northing coordinate in metres in the dataset's projected coordinate reference system.
- `senstat`: Pupils with a statement of SEN or an Education, Health and Care plan.
- `sennostat`: Pupils receiving SEN support without a statement or Education, Health and Care plan.
- `propsname`: Name of the proprietor or owning body recorded for the establishment.
- `previousestablishmentnumber`: Previous DfE establishment number associated with this record.
- `uprn`: Unique Property Reference Number for the establishment site.
- `sitename`: Name used to identify the establishment site or premises.
- `qabreport`: Quality-assurance or inspection body associated with the published report, such as Ofsted.
- `chnumber`: Companies House number recorded for the proprietor or operating organisation.
- `fsm`: Number of pupils recorded as eligible for free school meals.
- `accreditationexpirydate`: Date on which the establishment's recorded accreditation expires.

### `a_dft/bus_stops_naptan`

- `atcocode`: Unique national ATCO identifier for the stop point.
- `naptancode`: Short public-facing NaPTAN code printed or displayed for the stop.
- `platecode`: Local code shown on the physical stop plate where supplied.
- `cleardowncode`: Code used by some operators to clear or identify the stop in operational systems.
- `commonname`: Primary name by which the stop is publicly known.
- `commonnamelang`: Language code for the primary stop name.
- `shortcommonname`: Abbreviated public name for the stop where supplied.
- `shortcommonnamelang`: Language code for the abbreviated stop name.
- `landmark`: Nearby landmark used to help passengers locate the stop.
- `landmarklang`: Language code for the landmark text.
- `street`: Street or road on which the stop is located.
- `streetlang`: Language code for the street name.
- `crossing`: Nearby crossing or intersecting street used to describe the stop location.
- `crossinglang`: Language code for the crossing description.
- `indicator`: Location indicator distinguishing the stop, such as a stand, bay, direction or outside landmark.
- `indicatorlang`: Language code for the stop indicator.
- `bearing`: Compass direction faced or served by the stop, such as N, SW or E.
- `nptglocalitycode`: National Public Transport Gazetteer code for the stop's locality.
- `localityname`: NPTG locality name associated with the stop.
- `parentlocalityname`: Name of the parent locality containing the stop locality.
- `grandparentlocalityname`: Name of the higher-level locality containing the parent locality.
- `town`: Town or settlement recorded for the stop location.
- `townlang`: Language code for the town name, such as EN.
- `suburb`: Suburb or neighbourhood recorded for the stop.
- `suburblang`: Language code for the suburb name.
- `localitycentre`: Boolean indicator showing whether the stop represents a locality centre.
- `gridtype`: Coordinate grid system used for the stop location, such as UKOS.
- `easting`: Easting coordinate in metres in the dataset's projected coordinate reference system.
- `northing`: Northing coordinate in metres in the dataset's projected coordinate reference system.
- `stoptype`: NaPTAN stop-classification code identifying the transport stop or access-point type.
- `busstoptype`: NaPTAN bus-stop subtype, such as marked, hail-and-ride, flexible or unmarked.
- `timingstatus`: Operational timing-point status used in public transport scheduling.
- `defaultwaittime`: Default interchange waiting time recorded for the stop.
- `notes`: Additional publisher note about the stop record.
- `noteslang`: Language code for the stop notes.
- `administrativeareacode`: NPTG administrative-area code responsible for the stop record.
- `creationdatetime`: Date and time when the stop record was created.
- `modificationdatetime`: Date and time when the stop record was last modified.
- `revisionnumber`: Revision sequence number of the NaPTAN record.
- `modification`: Change action represented by the record, such as new, revise or delete.
- `status`: Lifecycle status of the stop record, such as active, inactive or pending.
- `stop_pk`: Internal primary-key value for the imported stop record.
